However, significant structural artifacts exist at the ground interface: paws lack distinct toe definition and appear fused/melted into the wood chips (Router severity 3). The animal_pose_auditor flagged MEDIUM risk (37% low-confidence keypoints), concentrated in hind limbs and hips, confirming anatomical uncertainty in the lower body structure. Faces and upper torsos are artifact-free, but the grounding is compromised.
key_defects: Color mismatch: Rabbits are brown/tan instead of requested red.
Structural artifact: Paws/feet blend into ground debris; toes indistinct.
Anatomical ambiguity: Hind limb structure lacks clear definition (pose auditor MEDIUM risk).
